name: Soundboard
description: Pads in the bar, hotkeys while Discord/Zoom has focus, and a virtual mic that carries your voice + the sounds on one device.
author: yami

barWidget.description: Pads in the bar, hotkeys while Discord/Zoom has focus, and a virtual mic that carries your voice + the sounds on one device.

schema.label: Monitor pads locally
schema.description: Also play pads on your speakers/headphones. Warning: on open speakers the mic can re-capture the pad.

schema.label: Voice source
schema.description: Pinned PipeWire source feeding the soundboard mic. Leave empty to auto-detect (omavoice, then default, then hardware).
